Implementing or redesigning BB-064 Oracle closure or BB-068 SCM delivery.
Changing the selected coding-agent/runtime strategy from the exact delivered BB-066/BB-067 profile.
Merging the review candidate, publishing product truth or claiming full organization lifecycle completion.
Claiming productivity, ROI or comparative product value; BB-069 proves feasibility only and BB-074 owns value comparison.
constraints: Worker execution requires BB-064 and BB-068 DONE and consumes their exact delivered artifacts/Living refs; READY plans are assumptions during research only.

BB-068 delivery transitively depends on BB-065..067. BB-069 consumes the exact delivered request-tracker fixture, runtime/sandbox profile and SCM provider rather than repinning or silently upgrading them.

architectureDecisions: D1: Implement BB-069 as a bounded integration/evidence harness under `scripts/delivery/first-slice/**`; do not add a generic product runtime abstraction. The harness composes delivered Oracle, DomainExecutionController/runtime adapter, SCM review delivery and existing QA/acceptance APIs.

D2: At worker start require BB-064 and BB-068 DONE, load their exact implementation-result/judgment refs and consolidated Living truth, and fail with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION if delivered package/API identities do not satisfy this plan. BB-068 transitively supplies the delivered BB-065 request-tracker fixture and BB-066/067 runtime/sandbox capability.

D3: Freeze one `FIRST_SLICE_PROTOCOL/v1` before live execution. It pins fixture/task, repository/base SHA, exact Oracle-required paths, prompt/profile/tool/runtime refs, acceptance-suite/browser digest, SCM review policy, preview policy, budgets, run matrix and seeded-defect transform digest.

D4: Backend context must be resolved through the delivered Oracle path using exact repositoryRef + base revision + required file paths. Persist every returned `sourceRef`; the coding runtime receives only the resolved/materialized bounded workspace and protocol prompt, never hidden QA assets.

D5: Execute NORM-01 through the delivered DomainExecutionController + coding-agent runtime/sandbox profile. Record executionAttemptId, runtimeInvocationKey hash, strategy/model/tool/profile hashes, conversation/session identity, starting/resulting workspace tree and all provider/budget evidence. Runtime SUCCEEDED is only a candidate-producing fact.

D6: Materialize the review candidate through delivered BB-068 SCM capability. Persist exact baseSha, commitSha, treeSha, changed-path digest, reviewId/head, currentness and check-run identities. BB-069 does not merge or bypass repository policy.

D7: Launch an isolated preview from the exact candidate tree using the delivered Docker/gVisor runtime primitives rather than adding Testcontainers/Dagger as a dependency. Candidate source is read-only; only a fresh per-run SQLite data volume and declared temp paths are writable; no model/SCM credentials or Docker socket enter the preview.

D8: Define a content-addressed `PREVIEW_RELEASE_RECEIPT` over candidate head/tree, runtime image digest, runsc/runtime version, preview-policy digest, application command/env digest, data-seed digest and verifier-facing endpoint contract. Record container/process instance id, mapped loopback port, start/ready/stop timestamps separately as an instance receipt; instance id is observation, not semantic release identity.

D9: Preview readiness is a bounded HTTP probe against the fixture API (`GET /requests` expected 200) plus process/container liveness; a listening port alone is insufficient. Startup timeout or early exit is preview failure evidence.

D10: Reuse the exact Playwright/browser lock delivered by BB-065 for browser QA and Node built-in fetch for API/persistence checks. QA acceptance code lives outside agent/candidate workspaces; Playwright trace is retained on failure and screenshots are captured on failure for bounded diagnostics.

D11: Independent QA feeds verifier-produced behavior/regression evidence into the existing non-mutating `QaWorker`/`QaCompletion` boundary (or its exact delivered successor). QA must bind the candidate revision + PREVIEW_RELEASE_RECEIPT and cannot use producer prose, runtime status or PR checks as behavior evidence.

D12: Calibrate QA sensitivity with a separate trusted seeded-defect control derived from the accepted candidate after the producer has already emitted success. The transform has a frozen digest and intentionally reintroduces one NORM-01 defect in a verifier-only copy; QA must reject it. The negative control never replaces/mutates the real candidate or its review.

D13: Execute four live evidence runs: three clean reset runs from the same frozen base/protocol and one interruption run. Each gets a fresh worktree, database volume, execution claim/attempt and review identity; reset means no source, DB, conversation or preview state is reused across runs.

D14: In the interruption run, kill the coding runtime only after durable OpenHands activity is observed. Fresh process recovery must reuse the exact semantic attempt/runtime binding/conversation required by BB-066 and continue through SCM candidate, preview and QA without a second semantic attempt/provider session.

D15: Each run has the same predeclared budget ceilings. Evidence includes wall time, model calls/tokens/API cost when known, tool/process limits, SCM operations, preview runtime and verifier duration. Missing cost/usage remains UNKNOWN and prevents a complete-feasibility claim for that run; it is never zero-filled.

D16: Report `FEASIBLE | NOT_FEASIBLE | INCONCLUSIVE` only. FEASIBLE requires all three clean runs plus kill/resume to produce independently accepted real candidates/previews within protocol and the seeded-defect control to be rejected. Comparative productivity/value fields are explicitly `NOT_EVALUATED` and deferred to BB-074.

expectedFromDependencies: BB-064 and BB-068 implementation-result + ACCEPT judgment artifacts

implementationSlices: S1 — Dependency/protocol gate: require BB-064 and BB-068 DONE, load exact delivered evidence/Living refs, resolve delivered request-tracker/runtime/SCM/browser identities, and materialize immutable FIRST_SLICE_PROTOCOL/v1. Exit: contract tests reject any dependency/profile/fixture drift or missing live prerequisite.

S2 — Oracle→agent→SCM path: from a reset controlled repository resolve exact Backend inputs through Oracle, execute NORM-01 through delivered DomainExecutionController/OpenHands/gVisor capability, and create the BB-068 review candidate without merge. Exit: one content-addressed run record binds Oracle sourceRefs → execution attempt/runtime → resulting tree → commit/tree/review/check identities.

S3 — Isolated preview: start the exact candidate in a separate runsc preview using read-only source and fresh SQLite volume, wait on GET /requests readiness, and emit PREVIEW_RELEASE_RECEIPT + instance receipt. Exit: drift/credential/socket/extra-mount/startup negatives fail before QA.

S4 — Independent QA + defect control: run verifier-owned API/persistence checks and Playwright browser checks, feed grounded evidence through existing QA completion, restart preview against the same run volume for persistence, then run a separate frozen seeded-defect variant and prove QA rejects it despite a producer-success claim. Exit: real candidate accepted and negative control rejected with distinct identities.

S5 — Repetition/recovery: perform three fully reset clean live runs plus one kill/resume run after durable agent activity. Fresh-process recovery must reuse exact semantic runtime binding and still reach candidate/preview/QA; every run records budgets/failures and no state leaks across reset boundaries.

S6 — Audit/consolidation: credential-free audit validates all content digests, run matrix, candidate/release/QA relations, provider request/usage evidence and negative controls; emit feasibility report separate from pilot value and update Living Docs only with actually demonstrated first-slice guarantees/limits.

negativeVerificationCases: Oracle sourceRef/repository revision differs from the frozen base or required path set.
Agent/runtime reports success but resulting source tree or BB-068 candidate relation differs.
Preview runs a tree/image/policy other than the exact release receipt or exposes undeclared mounts/credentials/Docker socket.
Port is open but GET /requests readiness/behavior fails and preview is still called ready.
QA consumes producer prose, PR status or runtime completion instead of verifier-owned behavior/regression evidence.
Seeded-defect control passes QA, mutates the real candidate, or is not distinguishable by exact digest.
A clean reset run reuses workspace, SQLite volume, conversation/session, execution attempt, review identity or preview instance from another run.
Kill/resume creates a second semantic attempt/provider session or loses the original runtime binding.
Missing provider usage/cost is recorded as zero or omitted from run completeness.
Three successful runs are used to claim productivity/ROI or BB-074 value before comparative protocol execution.
Live credentials/prerequisites are absent but audit marks the run matrix satisfied.

livingDocs.statement: Living truth may record only the demonstrated bounded first-slice: exact Oracle input, real coding runtime, exact SCM candidate, isolated preview, independent QA, reset/recovery evidence and explicit feasibility-only limits.

researchBasis.selectionRule: Public GitHub repositories used as examples have at least 1,000 stars. Stars qualify examples for inspection only; correctness comes from inspected contracts/source.

examples.observedPattern: Web-server readiness/timeout plus failure-retained traces and failure screenshots provide bounded independently inspectable browser evidence.
examples.decision: Reuse the exact Playwright/browser lock delivered by BB-065; BB-069 does not add or float a second browser version.

examples.observedPattern: Ephemeral containers expose mapped ports and use explicit HTTP/listening/log readiness strategies with bounded startup.
examples.decision: Borrow readiness/lifecycle semantics only; reject dependency because BB-067 already supplies the trusted Docker/gVisor launcher and adding another container authority duplicates lifecycle.

examples.observedPattern: Durable conversation/workspace execution remains the relevant coding-runtime seam.
examples.decision: Do not upgrade in BB-069. Consume the exact BB-066 delivered strategy/runtime identity (planned as SDK 1.49.4 at 3f47426e...) so first-slice proof does not mix integration validation with runtime upgrade.

researchBasis.smallestExistingCore: Use existing Oracle pull boundary, DomainExecutionController/runtime recovery, BB-068 SCM effect contract, existing QaWorker/QaCompletion and BB-065 verifier assets. New code is an integration/evidence harness only.

frozenBeforeRun: Oracle required paths and expected source classes
firstSliceProtocol.prohibitedChange: Any protocol identity change after first live dispatch starts a new experiment identity; prior runs remain evidence and cannot be silently pooled.

previewContract.authority: Preview launch is observation infrastructure only; it cannot accept QA, mutate SCM or publish product truth.
previewContract.isolation: Read-only candidate source; fresh writable SQLite volume only; no SCM/model credentials, host Docker socket or unrelated host mounts.
previewContract.readiness: GET /requests returns expected 200/schema within bounded timeout while process/container remains alive.

qaContract.inputs: Exact accepted candidate revision + PREVIEW_RELEASE_RECEIPT + verifier-owned frozen acceptance policy.
evidence: persistence after preview restart against same run DB volume
Playwright UI behavior, malicious-content text rendering, trace/screenshot refs
candidate/release identity and verifier code/browser digests
qaContract.independence: Verifier code/profile/seed transform are outside agent workspace and not writable by producer; QA is non-mutating and has no SCM/model credential.
qaContract.negativeControl: After producer-success record, apply frozen verifier-owned transform to a separate candidate copy that reintroduces one NORM-01 failure. QA must reject; control result is evaluator-sensitivity evidence, not the real candidate result.

runMatrix.resetRule: Every run begins from identical protocol/base but fresh worktree, database volume, semantic attempt/claim, agent runtime state, SCM review identity and preview instance.
runMatrix.interruptionRule: Kill after durable coding-runtime activity; recover from fresh Node/Python process using the delivered exact binding/session semantics; no second semantic attempt/provider session.
runMatrix.successRule: FEASIBLE only if all 4 required live runs are complete and accepted plus the seeded-defect control is rejected.

feasibilityContract.completeRun: All required identity/evidence/budget fields resolved; unknown provider effect/cost or missing QA/preview evidence makes run incomplete.
feasibilityContract.feasible: Three clean runs + one kill/resume run independently accepted under unchanged protocol and QA negative control rejected.
feasibilityContract.notFeasible: Any completed required run violates a mandatory criterion or the seeded-defect control is accepted.
feasibilityContract.inconclusive: Missing live prerequisite, unresolved provider effect/usage/cost, verifier infrastructure failure or incomplete run matrix.
feasibilityContract.pilotValue: NOT_EVALUATED; BB-074 owns comparative delivery-value measurement.
